Koshinski Asset Management Cut Its Apple (AAPL) Position; MIRVAC GROUP ORDINARY SHARES (MRVGF) Shorts Down By 61.1%
July 15, 2018 - By Gregory Tomko
Koshinski Asset Management Inc decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 4.32% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Koshinski Asset Management Inc sold 2,031 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 5.37%. The Koshinski Asset Management Inc holds 44,957 shares with $7.54 million value, down from 46,988 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $940.41B valuation. The stock increased 0.16% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $191.33. About 12.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since July 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.84 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
